Messages.Author: Maurice Pittet
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Can someone answer to these questions?

1) Can I use a Bum's Rush card against a tapped vampire of my prey?

2) How and when can I use the Hidden Lurker card?

3) How can I avoid the Theft of Vitae card? (what a nightmare!)

4) I am looking for a Brujah deck without too much R cards and some
explanations how to use it.

Thanks.
Maurice

Messages.Author: Everett Littles
Messages.Body:
On Wed, 1 May 1996, Maurice Pittet wrote:

Ok I'll attempt to answer these. Guys correct me if I am wrong

> 1) Can I use a Bum's Rush card against a tapped vampire of my prey?

Yes.

> 2) How and when can I use the Hidden Lurker card?

When combat is over between two minions, play the HL then tap one of your
minions and then combat begins with the newly tapped minion and the
minion you just got out of combat with

> 3) How can I avoid the Theft of Vitae card? (what a nightmare!)

Not too familar with the card but you can use cards that give you first
strike and hope to get the other minion in torpor before he can play it.

> 4) I am looking for a Brujah deck without too much R cards and some
> explanations how to use it.

Brujah? Gross! Ventrue all the way babeeeeeee. =P

> Thanks.
> Maurice

>When combat is over between two minions, play the HL then tap one of your

And officially, your predator or prey can block the hidden lurker
action (an undirected action, according to the RTR's view ofabsent (D)
symbols).

Of course, most people use a house rule that makes HL an action
modifier - a mirror of its Fast Reacting cousin.

>
>> 3) How can I avoid the Theft of Vitae card? (what a nightmare!)
>Not too familar with the card but you can use cards that give you first
>strike and hope to get the other minion in torpor before he can play it.

That or Dodge or Strike: End combat. (Or play Immortal Grapple at
close range)

Messages.Author: Stuart J. Pieloch
Messages.Body:
Everett Littles <elit...@cymbal.aix.calpoly.edu> writes:

>> 3) How can I avoid the Theft of Vitae card? (what a nightmare!)

Try Fortitude - if you have prevented all of the damage and not
paid any blood for anything, then taste won't gain the opposing
vamp any blood. think ventrue. think ventrue with guns and trap.

>> 4) I am looking for a Brujah deck without too much R cards and some
>> explanations how to use it.

Think
Yuri/hector/anvil/dre/tura/volner(2ea)
Think
Bum's rush/und strength/pulled fangs/acrobatics/majesty/
legal manipulations/info hwy/immortal grapple (if you have em)
(10 ea)(10 ea)(10 ea)(10 ea)(10 ea)(10 ea)(10 ea)(10 ea)(10 ea)
Either rush your preys vamps till they are dead and then bleed
or bleed with legal manipulations and if they block
Imm grapple if you can, undead strength with pulled fangs or dodge+und strength
with pulled fangs. or if they are going to beat up on you - majesty.

It has no defense so the info hwys help you get out vamps fast and if you
wind up with a serious offensive predator bum's rush him and make him back off.

Just my 2 pool
